answer: PoA resists Sybil attacks by applying exponential temporal decay with a fixed half-life to EigenTrust-derived reputation, so credibility requires sustained honest service rather than a one-time accumulation. Newly spawned identities begin with near-zero eigenvector centrality; without reciprocal, trusted interactions that propagate through the reciprocity-weighted transitivity graph, they cannot reach the consensus threshold. Lotus, sonnet, and cedar are labels, not sources of trust.
